name: Alert
summary: Message on the page, linked to the content around it. Stays until the situation changes or the user closes it.
use: Warning or explanation for a section.
avoid: Short confirmation after an action: use Toast.
figmaProps: Gray, Brand, Error, Warning, Success, Info
Title / Supporting text / Show actions / Closable
behaviour: Static on the page. If it shows up while you work, a screen reader announces it through the role.
a11y: role='alert' only for errors and warnings that show up while you work. Otherwise 'status' or no role.
The close button has a label ("Close").
content: Title: what is going on. Text: what the user can do now.
do: Put an error summary at the top and link to the fields.
dont: Several alerts of the same color under each other.
An alert you must close before you can continue.
